summary_1line: Mudgala rejects heaven seeking liberation; later Duryodhana gains Durvasa’s favor and plots to send him to the Pandavas at a troublesome moment.

image_candidates.scene_text: The serene sage Mudgala calmly dismisses a radiant celestial messenger offering heaven while sitting in austere meditation.
Duryodhana humbly serving the fiery sage Durvasa surrounded by ten thousand disciples in the Kuru palace.
Duryodhana secretly clasping Karna’s hand in satisfaction after persuading Durvasa to visit the Pandavas at night.
